name: Rovno
summary: The Rovno programme measured reactor-antineutrino spectra, yields and power/fuel evolution at the site now known as Rivne in Ukraine. Its multiple detector configurations are part of the historical short-baseline reactor dataset.
detection_principle: Electron antineutrinos interact with protons through inverse beta decay. Scintillator and neutron-counting configurations were used in distinct campaigns; changes with distance, thermal power and fuel evolution were compared with reactor calculations.
